watches.name: Rare Ones Mechanical Watch
watches.description: Rare Ones by Melofaith and LaMelo Ball is a customisable automatic mechanical watch available through Memorigin, powered by a Japanese self-winding movement with a 42-hour power reserve. The watch features a sturdy, square-shaped steel case with a diameter measuring approximately 42mm and a thickness of about 13mm. The focus is on the detachable bezel and face plate design, with each component available in more than ten colors, allowing customers to freely build their own watch with their favorite case colors in accordance with their preferences. Apart from the freely combinable case colors, the inner bezel is available in the Charlotte Hornets' jersey colors - purple and teal - and LaMelo's favorite shades of red with brown and white. The striking orange seconds hand is decorated with LaMelo's jersey number "1" at the tail, depicting his quest to seize every second and take the lead on the field. A quick-release system is equipped with the watch strap, allowing customers to replace the strap by selecting from an array of colors of steel or cowhide straps, without the need to utilize any tools. The different color components can be interblended to create a multitude of combinations, brightening up your summer days ahead!
